sourceReview.reason: Robinhood's product page confirms that Stock Tokens may be used as collateral, but it does not identify Morpho or date this launch. The Morpho-specific launch and external-app claim remain attributable to social posts and derivative snippets, without a readable dated primary announcement or two independent full-text reports.
